description: Capture every adventure in stunning detail with the 5K Ultra HD Action Camera, designed for thrill-seekers, travelers, vloggers, cyclists, and outdoor enthusiasts. Featuring 5K video recording, 48MP high-resolution photos, and a 170° ultra-wide-angle lens, this action camera lets you record every exciting moment with exceptional clarity and vibrant colors. The camera is equipped with a 2.0-inch rear IPS display and a 1.4-inch front screen, making it perfect for selfies, vlogging, and easy framing. Built-in Electronic Image Stabilization (EIS) helps reduce unwanted shakes and vibrations, delivering smoother and more professional-looking videos during biking, hiking, skiing, or other action-packed activities. With built-in WiFi, you can instantly connect the camera to your smartphone using the iSmart DV2 App to preview, download, and share your photos and videos without removing the memory card. The included waterproof housing allows you to capture amazing underwater footage, making it ideal for swimming, snorkeling, surfing, diving, and other water sports.
